Updated on Sep 1, 2026 Incorporated in 2003, Pranav Constructions Limited is an Indian construction company specializing in residential, commercial, and infrastructure development projects. Key Services: Residential Projects: Develop affordable housing, premium apartments, and gated communities. Commercial Projects: Builds office spaces, retail centers, and mixed-use developments. Infrastructure Development: Engaged in road construction, bridges, water supply projects, and other public infrastructure works. Redevelopment Expertise: The company has in-house capabilities to manage the entire redevelopment process, including: Tendering Stage – Bidding for projects. Pre-Construction Stage – Planning and approvals. Construction Stage – Project execution. Post-Construction Stage – Final handover and management. Market Position & Projects: Leader in MCGM Redevelopment Projects in Mumbai's Western Suburbs (based on units supplied and projects completed/under construction). Completed Redevelopment Projects: 26 projects with a total developable area of 1.25 million sq. ft. Some notable projects include: Gold Coin CHSL, Gala Apartments CHSL, Ramesh Mandir CHSL, New Shalimar Apartments CHSL, Malad Marudhar CHSL, and Tiara CHSL in Malad. Popular Terrace CHSL in Borivali. Under-Construction Redevelopment Projects: 11 projects with 1.07 million sq. ft. of total developable area. Upcoming Redevelopment Projects: 21 projects with 1.87 million sq. ft. of total developable area. Growth & Expansion: Between March 31, 2012, and March 31, 2021, the company procured 27 redevelopment projects with a total developable area of 1.86 million sq. ft. From April 1, 2021, to December 31, 2024, it secured 31 redevelopment projects covering 2.33 million sq. ft. faqs.question: How to apply in Pranav Constructions IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Pranav Constructions IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Pranav Constructions IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Pranav Constructions IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Pranav Constructions IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
